task_instance: Implement a Terraform Provider Action (example_restart_service) in a minimal terraform-plugin-framework provider: one-time ProviderWithActions scaffolding (Actions() method, ActionData set in Configure), the action's Schema (required service_id, optional/validated timeout attribute), its Invoke method with SendProgress calls and error diagnostics, a unit test exercising Metadata/Schema/Configure, an example HCL config using an action_trigger block, and a docs/actions/*.md page.
evidence: Created a Go module (go.mod: example.com/terraform-provider-example) and pulled real dependencies from the network: github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework v1.19.0 and terraform-plugin-framework-validators v0.19.0 (go mod tidy succeeded, go1.25 toolchain auto-downloaded). Implemented internal/provider/provider.go (exampleProvider implementing provider.Provider + provider.ProviderWithActions, Configure setting resp.ActionData) and internal/provider/restart_service_action.go (restartServiceAction implementing action.Action: Metadata, Schema with service_id/timeout attributes + int64validator.Between, Configure doing the ProviderData type-assertion pattern, and Invoke calling resp.SendProgress and resp.Diagnostics.AddError). `go build -o /dev/null ./...` succeeded (BUILD_OK). `gofmt -l .` reported nothing after formatting fixes. Wrote internal/provider/restart_service_action_test.go with two tests exercising the schema and the Configure error path; `go test -c -o /dev/null ./internal/provider` compiled and `go test ./internal/provider -run TestRestartServiceAction -v` passed both tests (PASS, ok). Added examples/restart_service.tf using the action{}/action_trigger{} HCL pattern from the skill and validated its syntax with `terraform fmt -check -diff` (exit 0, no diff) using the sandbox's Terraform v1.9.8 binary. Added docs/actions/restart_service.md following the skill's documentation template (warning, example, argument reference). One real-world discrepancy found and worked around: the skill's schema example shows action Int64Attribute with Computed+Default fields, but terraform-plugin-framework v1.19.0's action/schema.Int64Attribute has no Computed/Default fields (actions have no persisted state) -- default handling was moved into Invoke instead, and this was verified by the initial compile error and the subsequent successful build. Not verified end-to-end: a live `terraform apply` invoking the action via action_trigger, since Terraform actions require CLI >= 1.14 and this sandbox has Terraform 1.9.8 (below that version, and no newer terraform binary could be installed/verified without broader environment changes within the time budget); the Go-side implementation, compilation, and unit tests fully verify the skill's core coding deliverable, and the HCL was independently confirmed syntactically valid.
